# jsSHA 3.3.0

The OBS pages use this locally hosted SHA-256 build for their authentication fallback when Web Crypto is unavailable.

`sha256.js` is copied unchanged from `dist/sha256.js` in the [jssha 3.3.0 package](https://registry.npmjs.org/jssha/-/jssha-3.3.0.tgz). The package's full [BSD-3-Clause notice](LICENSE) is also included unchanged. Preserve both that notice and the bundle's existing Brian Turek and Paul Johnston/contributor credits.

The browser build is self-contained and has no additional runtime dependencies.

Source: [jsSHA v3.3.0](https://github.com/Caligatio/jsSHA/tree/v3.3.0).
Archive SHA-256: `725db34872e83c28fe49fe27bfeaa61d58eafdd569a37ec2b19c7c5e3436ec13`.
